name: My Eternal Night with a Star
source:
In the warm embrace of her lover and cosy blankets, both protecting her from the harshness of a windy and rainy evening, Araceli feels unsually anxious: she and her boyfriend, Arcturus, agreed on having their first sexual intercourse... but Araceli doesn't feel ready. Will she be able to tell this to her lover? And will she get ready? Perhaps she would, if this night could be eternal...

[From [url=https://chimeriquement.itch.io/my-eternal-night-with-a-star]itch.io[/url]]

Made for [url=/p19309]Butter Blanc[/url]'s birthday
translation:
爱人温暖的怀抱和舒适的毯子都保护她免受风雨交加的严酷夜晚，阿拉塞利感到异常焦虑：她和男友阿克图洛斯同意进行第一次性交……但阿拉塞利感觉还没有准备好。她能把这件事告诉她的爱人吗？她会准备好吗？如果这个夜晚可以成为永恒的话，也许她会的……
